plan.title: RFQ Counter Offer Accepted and Awarded

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen with Vendor A’s own bid.
Enable eRFX projects for the scenario.
Ensure RFQ counter offers are available.
Open the buyer comparison grid required to initiate the counter offer.
Send Vendor A a counter offer reducing the bid to 90.
Verify the buyer grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Move to Vendor A’s separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer.
Return to the buyer’s event page.
Verify the buyer sees Vendor A’s counter offer as accepted.
Reopen Master QCS after acceptance to inspect the revised bid used for awarding.
Verify Vendor A’s accepted RFQ rate is 90.
Award the closed RFQ to Vendor A using the accepted bid.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
